title: Proptest scaffolding for SIMD-vs-scalar equivalence
description:
Add a shared test helper that every new SIMD kernel uses to prove correctness equivalence with the scalar baseline.

## Deliverables

1. `crates/gf2-core/tests/simd_equiv/mod.rs` (new): exports `assert_simd_matches_scalar<F, G, T>(scalar: F, simd: G, gen: impl Strategy<Value = T>)` that runs proptest over the generator and asserts bit-exact equality.
2. Word-boundary helper: `WORD_BOUNDARY_LENGTHS: &[usize] = &[0, 1, 63, 64, 65, 127, 128, 129, 255, 256, 257]`. Each new SIMD kernel adds a `#[test]` that iterates this list.
3. Alignment helper: produces `&[u64]` slices at offsets 0..7 within an over-allocated buffer to exercise unaligned paths.
4. Demo unit test exercising the helper against `LogicalFns::xor_fn` (scalar) vs. AVX2 `xor_inplace_avx2` (simd).

## Success criteria

- [hard] Helper compiles, fast-tier nextest passes.
- [hard] Demo test catches a deliberate one-bit mutation in the scalar fn (verify the test actually tests).
- [hard] No new dependencies added beyond what `gf2-core` and `proptest` already provide.
